title: Novel biomarkers and the natriuretic peptide-cGMP signal pathway in the Cardiooncology
summary: Aim of the project is to assess the association of the change of natriuretic peptides and its seconder messenger cGMP and further biomarkers with cardiovascular complications under potential cardiotoxic breast cancer therapy, including anthracyclines, radiotherapy and HER2-targeted therapies.

interventions.name: Women with early breast cancer scheduled for chemotherapy that include therapy regimes with cardiotoxic  potential.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Informed consent 
Age ≥18 years 
Women with early breast cancer scheduled for chemotherapy that include cardiotoxic agents
Exclusion criteria:
Severe renal insufficiency (GFR<30ml/min) 
LVEF<40%
NT-proBNP>2xULN (250 pg/ml)
life expectancy of ≤12 weeks
